drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Attached is our proposed settlement agreement for discussion. The settlement amount and payment timing remain bracketed for agreement. We have clarified when the release becomes effective and added customary confidentiality exceptions. The draft remains subject to client approval and execution.

Please let us have your comments.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] by [PAYMENT DEADLINE], by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. The parties shall independently verify payment instructions before any transfer.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff's receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the dispute described in the Recitals that accrued on or before the date of execution of this Agreement. This release does not waive any right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures necessary to enforce this Agreement; and disclosures required by law or legal process. To the extent legally permitted, a party required to disclose shall give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Thank you for flagging the inadvertent disclosure and for agreeing not to use or further disclose the material. We assert privilege over that material and request its return or deletion, including copies and extracts, and written confirmation. If applicable preservation requirements prevent deletion, please segregate the affected original with access restricted to those necessary to resolve the privilege issue, without substantive use or further disclosure. We do not intend any waiver and reserve all rights.

We will provide a clean replacement after verifying removal of the inadvertently disclosed material. Please use only that replacement for further drafting.

Subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement, we propose payment within ten business days after the last party signs. We are obtaining instructions on the settlement amount and the precise factual description of the underlying dispute; neither is supplied by the existing draft. The revised recital therefore marks the required identifying details expressly, and the release is limited to that identified dispute. No amount or final release scope is agreed at this stage.

Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the following dispute (the “Dispute”): [TO BE CONFIRMED BEFORE EXECUTION: identify the relevant transaction or occurrence, agreement and date if applicable, conduct at issue and relevant period, and any pending proceeding by court and case number].

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT—SUBJECT TO CLIENT APPROVAL] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after the date on which the last party signs this Agreement, by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. This release does not extend to unrelated transactions or occurrences and does not waive any right to enforce this Agreement.
